lure: An unpaid toll with a big late fee if not paid today
ask: Pay on a look-alike payment page

message.body: E-ZPass: unpaid toll of $4.50. Pay today to avoid a $50 late fee: https://ezpass-pay.test/toll

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: This is not E-ZPass.
reasons: The link is not on the toll agency's website.
A small amount and a large late fee is the toll scam.
